bsr_keybind_desc: Reloads aimed or nearby sentry guns without picking them up.
bsr_options_desc: Configure hotkey sentry gun reloading behavior and options.
bsr_opt_target_mode_desc: Choose how sentry guns are targeted when pressing the reload keybind.
bsr_opt_max_range_desc: Maximum distance from which a sentry gun can be reloaded.
bsr_opt_allow_team_sentries_desc: Allow reloading other players' sentry guns using your ammo.
bsr_opt_repair_health_desc: Also restore sentry health to full when reloading (Host only).
bsr_opt_play_sound_desc: Play audio feedback when a sentry is reloaded.
bsr_opt_show_hint_desc: Display an on-screen notification when a sentry is reloaded.
bsr_hint_none_in_range: No sentry gun in range to reload.
bsr_hint_already_full: Sentry gun is already fully loaded.
bsr_hint_no_ammo: Not enough ammo to reload sentry gun!
